## Behavior

Describe the trigger, expected result, and actual result.

## Reproduction

Include the commit, Python version, redacted command, and smallest nonsensitive
fixture. State whether the optional semantic client was installed. Do not attach
private corpora, credentials, or secret-bearing URLs.

## Verification

Include exit status, relevant redacted stderr, and output/provenance differences.
For sensitive issues use the security reporting policy instead of this form.
